push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Amarillo | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #5)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a perfect 10.0 against FC Amarillo. Perfect Game #5. I don't have a speech for this. I'm just gonna stand here and clap.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 5th Perfect Game for us. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 4 shots at FC Amarillo's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ 2 key passes. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ Man of the Match, your 15th for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.
+ You and buddskees were a two-person band and the crowd loved it.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 2, down from your usual 6. Back to basics: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- Pass accuracy: 78%. That's a B. The A-students among forwards are at 88%+.

Practice this: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

One thought for the road, PhogsToffees: The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

Keep being you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Amarillo | You: 7.9
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.9 for a midfielder. A little under, a little lesson, a lot of upside.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against FC Amarillo, your first since Oct 14. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ 1 key pass. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ You saw PhogsToffees's run before PhogsToffees did.
+ Tackles attempted 4, up from your usual 2. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (14 vs their best 13). That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD
- 70% passing (14 of 20, down from your usual 78%). Real quick: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
- Tackle success 25%, down from your usual 64%. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- You and BellyTb1 need to sync up on forcing passes: give each other short options.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 2. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Tidy that up.

Daily reps: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Between you and me, buddskees: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

Water the plant; it'll grow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Amarillo | You: 7.6
push.body:
A 7.6, BellyTb1. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. You played the pass before the defense knew it was a possibility.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (15 vs their best 13). That's the reliable kind of good.
+ Took care of FC Amarillo 4-3. Proud of the group.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted (down from your usual 4). Mark my words: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Little by little.
- 62% passing (15 of 24, down from your usual 75%). My two cents: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Small fix, big smile.
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Try this: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
- You and buddskees have a shared to-do on forcing passes: give each other short options.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.6 (best was PhogsToffees's 10.0). That has to tighten up.

Try this in practice: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

BellyTb1, from me to you: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

I'm in your corner, always. - Coach Lasso
